description: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) 2025, line 10 for the bounded class: line 7 unemployment compensation plus line 8b Form W-2G gambling winnings, when every unsupported Part I income class (including gambling winnings without a Form W-2G and business gambling), repayment, and residual Form 1099-G payment class is explicitly declared absent. Not a general Schedule 1 completeness claim.

blocked.explain: Schedule 1 line 10 is blocked because a Form 1099-K statement is unresolved or the Form 1099-K statements are not confirmed complete, the Form W-2G box 1 family is not confirmed complete, a recorded Form W-2G is held by the gambling/other Schedule A declaration, absence authority (including the 'no other income except Form W-2G' answer) is incomplete, an excluded class is present, or unemployment is unclosed.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes zero because the supporting source family is attested closed-empty under complete authority.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero under complete authority.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value is published because a completeness or guard condition is not satisfied.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes complete Schedule 1 line 10 additional income (unemployment plus Form W-2G gambling winnings) under explicit Part I absence authority.

label: Additional income
